content: Judah Lewis is an American actor, best known for his roles in films like "Demolition" (2015) alongside Jake Gyllenhaal and "The Babysitter" (2017) and its sequel "The Babysitter: Killer Queen" (2020). He was born on May 13, 2000, in the United States. Lewis gained more recognition through his performances in Netflix horror-comedy films. He has also appeared in TV shows, but he is primarily known for his film work.
